'''Allanteen VI''', or '''Allanteen Six''', also referred to simply as '''Allanteen''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Allanteen system/Legends|Allanteen system]] in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. it was the site of the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]].

==Description==
Allanteen VI was situated in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and located at the intersection of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]],<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[77 Sectors]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> It was the site of the [[Allanteen VI shipyards/Legends|Allanteen Six shipyards]].<ref name="WS" />

==History==
Allanteen VI was a major naval hub since the restoration of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] circa [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], and was the site of important [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Allanteen|battle]] won by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

Although the Allanteen system was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TEA" /> Allanteen VI was a major Republic shipyard during the conflict. The Allanteen Six shipyards manufactured [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] upgraded his taskforce of ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers in these shipyards.<ref name="WS" /> The Allanteen shipyards were turned into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military shipyards after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and dedicated to the production of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked the Expansion Region. They conquered Allanteen VI and split their advance in two, with one force [[Battle of Tynna|attacking]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]] and the other passing through the [[Tlactehon system/Legends|Tlactehon system]] to conquer [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]].<ref name="TEA" />
